heading: Welcome to the Solar Policy Explorer
body: Explore the international policy environment for behind-the-meter solar and storage. Identify impactful policy gaps to accelerate the energy transition

heading: The scoreboard
body: Every jurisdiction with data, ranked by how much of the questionnaire is actually answered - not by score, so the thin rows are as visible as the impressive ones.
spotlightCaption: Select a jurisdiction to view its details.
Jump straight to a jurisdiction by name, from anywhere on the map.
Narrow the list by continent, country or score band, and change what it's sorted by.
Score and data completeness, broken down by section.
The changes that would raise this jurisdiction's score the most, ranked by weighted points.
Every question, its rubric, and the evidence behind each answer - editable by anyone.
Click a rubric tier to record what's actually in place, then use Evidence to add the citation behind it - a law, a regulator decision, or a market operator's own data.
Bundle everything you've changed this session into one suggestion, with your name and organisation - an admin reviews it before it's accepted or reverted.
Open two jurisdictions side by side, with a shared tab and section selection.
The Charter is under About, how scoring works is in Help - or dig into the question set yourself in the Admin console.

heading: Start exploring
body: Pick a jurisdiction, or browse the scoreboard and update missing policy information.
